title: Hazardous fuel removal on 10 high-risk parcels
summary: The emergency management agency's administrator said a presentation to the mayor is coming soon to bring the wildfire risk pieces together. The agency has asked for $1 million to remove hazardous fuels, meaning plants that can feed wildfires. It says 10 high-priority parcels covering 1,100 acres need work, and clearing the grass on them would cost about $3.3 million.
